definitions.explanation: A person who submits articles, essays, or other written works to a publication, often as an outside writer rather than a staff member.

examples.japanese: {寄稿者|きこうしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{募集|ぼしゅう}→募集：03035_boshuu⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{雑誌|ざっし}→雑誌：00686_zasshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{寄稿者|きこうしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: This magazine has many famous authors among its contributors.

examples.japanese: {寄稿者|きこうしゃ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦コラム→コラム：10856_koramu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いている→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: I write a column for the newspaper as a contributor.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{寄稿|きこう}→寄稿：17076_kikou⟧ (contribution of a manuscript) + ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). ⟦{寄稿|きこう}→寄稿：17076_kikou⟧ itself combines {寄|き} (to send, to contribute) + {稿|こう} (manuscript, draft). Used in publishing, journalism, and academic contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {寄稿者|きこうしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{募|つの}る→募る：10878_tsunoru⟧: to call for contributors
- {寄稿者|きこうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一覧|いちらん}→一覧：17694_ichiran⟧: list of contributors
- ⟦{外部|がいぶ}→外部：00052_gaibu⟧{寄稿者|きこうしゃ}: outside contributor
- ⟦{定期|ていき}→定期：03538_teiki⟧{寄稿者|きこうしゃ}: regular contributor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{執筆者|しっぴつしゃ}→執筆者：22346_shippitsusha⟧: writer, author — more general, referring to anyone who writes, while {寄稿者|きこうしゃ} specifically implies contributing to an external publication
- ⟦{投稿者|とうこうしゃ}→投稿者：23839_toukousha⟧: poster, submitter — used more broadly including social media posts and reader submissions, while {寄稿者|きこうしゃ} implies a more formal contribution
